title: Force a must-do project, with a recorded reason

expected.says: Run's report for the tiny portfolio matches the expected report

blueprint.signature: def build(projects: list[Project], request: Request) -> Built
blueprint.contract: As before, except that a project in request.must_do gets a row `must_<pid>`, its starts over its window summing to exactly 1, in place of `once_<pid>`.
blueprint.idea: A must-do is a rule about the plan, so it is a row; the model still chooses the year.

lesson.title: 14.4.3 A Must-Do Override That Needs a Recorded Reason

blueprint.signature: def check(projects: list[Project], request: Request) -> None
blueprint.contract: As before, and raises ValueError for a must-do override that names a project not in the portfolio, or whose reason is empty or only white space.
blueprint.idea: The reason is data the model never reads, so it is checked before solving.

lesson.title: 14.4.3 A Must-Do Override That Needs a Recorded Reason
